api: FixedZeroShotReader(model_dir,counters,progress,deadline), lazy constructor; token_count(context,hypothesis)->int; score(context,hypothesis)->dict; receipt property
progress: Callback takes one dictionary and must synchronously fsync before returning. BEFORE/COMPLETED events bracket tokenizer init, model init, and every forward. Attempt counters increment before calls; completion counters increment only after validation.
retrieval: Separate frozen worker: top_k1 ENTIRE source excerpt, actual_native then lexical then positional for each case, exact source IDs and character/UTF8 spans retained. No paragraph parser or selection using gold.
over_budget: Fail before forward. No silent truncation or retry.
probabilities: Stable float64 mathematical softmax over exactly the three selected next-token logits; normalization tolerance1e-8, no clipping, fixed first-code tie rule. Finite log probabilities are also retained for proper diagnostic NLL.
truth_semantics: Labels describe only supplied evidence. Retrieval miss does not assert global insufficiency. Unit/period structural ambiguity guard is separate from model probabilities and must not fabricate label C.
interpretation: Six unseen authored CC0 engineering cases may qualify or fail this technical reader workload. They do not establish benchmark generalization, calibrated probabilities, genuine confirmation, or promotion.
